summary: Founder-only, private, local-workstation AI coding/research assistant: repository inspection, code search/explanation, code and test generation, build/runtime/test failure diagnosis, migration/documentation generation, experimental indicator/strategy prototyping, sandboxed local tool execution, diff preparation, and Founder-review commit staging, with maintained task history/context and optional routing between local reasoning and coding models.
purpose: Give the Founder a private, sandboxed coding/research assistant without extending any trading authority, execution capability, or customer-facing surface.
groundwork_required_now: Groundwork Required Now

API_or_service_owner: Founder-local coding-assistant service (local models; optional reasoning/coding model routing)
acceptance_summary: Founder Sage Developer Mode can inspect/search/explain/generate code, tests, and diffs, and stage commits for Founder review, entirely within an explicit repository allowlist on the Founder's local workstation. It cannot push, merge, force-push, rewrite history, or delete a protected branch; cannot spend money or change production credentials; cannot disclose secrets; cannot alter security/privacy boundaries or any deterministic trading-safety control without explicit Founder approval and independent validation; and has no broker/order-submission authority merely because coding tools are available. Every action is logged, every change is recoverable via clean-diff rollback, and suggested/working-tree/staged/committed/pushed code states are always distinguishable to the Founder.
release_history: Created in audit repair pass (2026-07-26) per Founder Sage Developer Mode requirement.
